{"body":"Verified the migration of kbbl core to runtime-neutral AgentRuntime:

1. AgentRuntime Registry:
   - Defined `AgentRuntime`, `RuntimeDescriptor`, `RuntimeConfig`, `ResumeRef`, `RuntimeSnapshotContrib`, and `RuntimeRegistry` in `core/runtime.ts`.
   - `createRuntimeRegistry()` properly validates unique IDs and sets default runtime.
   - `core/runtime-interface.ts` re-exports from `./runtime` cleanly.

2. Claude Code Adapter:
   - `createClaudeCodeRuntime` in `adapters/claude-code/index.ts` implements both `AgentRuntime` and legacy `AppRuntime`.
   - Implements `spawn`, `terminate`, `events`, `send`, `resolveResumeRef`, `reconstructSnapshot`, `classifyEvent`, and `mountRoutes`.
   - Descriptors, resume refs, and snapshot reconstructions are covered by unit tests.

3. Session Layer & Sessions Handler:
   - `Session` in `core/session/session.ts` supports `attachRuntime()` alongside legacy `spawn()`, tracking `runtimeId` and `runtimeSid`.
   - `SessionManager` in `core/session/session-manager.ts` accepts `registry` and delegates spawn / lookup / resume operations to the configured runtime.
   - `mountSessionsRoutes` in `core/server/handlers/sessions.ts` checks model allowlist via `registry` and delegates resume resolution via `runtime.resolveResumeRef`.
   - All Claude Code specific imports removed from `core/session/session-manager.ts`, `core/server/handlers/sessions.ts`, and `core/orchestrator/backends/kbbl-chat.ts`.

Verification checks:
- Typecheck: `tsc --noEmit` runs cleanly with no errors.
- Test suite: All 61 tests across 8 test suites pass.","title":"Verify AgentRuntime migration in kbbl core"}

submission.body:
Verified the migration of kbbl core to runtime-neutral AgentRuntime:

1. AgentRuntime Registry:
   - Defined `AgentRuntime`, `RuntimeDescriptor`, `RuntimeConfig`, `ResumeRef`, `RuntimeSnapshotContrib`, and `RuntimeRegistry` in `core/runtime.ts`.
   - `createRuntimeRegistry()` properly validates unique IDs and sets default runtime.
   - `core/runtime-interface.ts` re-exports from `./runtime` cleanly.

2. Claude Code Adapter:
   - `createClaudeCodeRuntime` in `adapters/claude-code/index.ts` implements both `AgentRuntime` and legacy `AppRuntime`.
   - Implements `spawn`, `terminate`, `events`, `send`, `resolveResumeRef`, `reconstructSnapshot`, `classifyEvent`, and `mountRoutes`.
   - Descriptors, resume refs, and snapshot reconstructions are covered by unit tests.

3. Session Layer & Sessions Handler:
   - `Session` in `core/session/session.ts` supports `attachRuntime()` alongside legacy `spawn()`, tracking `runtimeId` and `runtimeSid`.
   - `SessionManager` in `core/session/session-manager.ts` accepts `registry` and delegates spawn / lookup / resume operations to the configured runtime.
   - `mountSessionsRoutes` in `core/server/handlers/sessions.ts` checks model allowlist via `registry` and delegates resume resolution via `runtime.resolveResumeRef`.
   - All Claude Code specific imports removed from `core/session/session-manager.ts`, `core/server/handlers/sessions.ts`, and `core/orchestrator/backends/kbbl-chat.ts`.

Verification checks:
- Typecheck: `tsc --noEmit` runs cleanly with no errors.
- Test suite: All 61 tests across 8 test suites pass.

   - `createClaudeCodeRuntime` in `adapters/claude-code/index.ts` implements both `AgentRuntime` and legacy `AppRuntime`.

   - `Session` in `core/session/session.ts` supports `attachRuntime()` alongside legacy `spawn()`, tracking `runtimeId` and `runtimeSid`.

   - `mountSessionsRoutes` in `core/server/handlers/sessions.ts` checks model allowlist via `registry` and delegates resume resolution via `runtime.resolveResumeRef`.
   - All Claude Code specific imports removed from `core/session/session-manager.ts`, `core/server/handlers/sessions.ts`, and `core/orchestrator/backends/kbbl-chat.ts`.
